title: How an AI Economy Behaves: A Multi-Agent Simulation in Which AI Companies Learn to Compete by Reinforcement Learning
summary: We present an open, reproducible simulation of a stylised AI industry over ten years and let AI product companies learn to compete in it by reinforcement learning (RL). The simulated economy links a chip fabricator, chip designers, data centres, frontier and open-weight model providers, 5–12 competing AI product companies and 300 enterprise customers in three sectors. Companies decide which use cases to pursue, which model to build on, how much to spend, and when to pilot, launch, scale or stop, facing uncertain technology, hidden customer value, compute shortages and rivals.
